title: Session 1 greedy construction demonstration
notes: Demonstration on the ten public instances with the fixed 30-second budget. The greedy nearest-neighbour constructor and the simple randomized constructor illustrate the report before teams develop local search in Session 2 and more advanced metaheuristics in Session 3. Both participate in this illustrative ranking; these are not student submissions or course marks.

environment.security: process deadlines are not a security sandbox

ranking_rule.formula: ranking grade = 8 × mean(best ranked feasible cost / submitted cost)
ranking_rule.reference: Best observed feasible cost among ranked solvers for the same instance and seed
ranking_rule.zero_reference: 1 if both costs are zero, otherwise 0
ranking_rule.weights: Every instance and every seed have equal weight; failures remain in the denominator
ranking_rule.note: Observed references are not proven optima. Nonranked baselines do not change grades.
